title: capsicum annuum var. conicum
intro: Capsicum annuum var. conicum, commonly known as the cherry pepper, is a variety of the Capsicum annuum plant, which is a sweet pepper species. It is rich in antioxidants and has been traditionally used to support overall health and wellness. The therapeutic actions of cherry pepper include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system. The bioactive constituents of cherry pepper include capsaicin, carotenoids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
